text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel decided to watch the 
Kikuka-sho from the sidelines. Meanwhile, 
news broke that Biwa Hayahide was 
temporarily hospitalized to look after her 
health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even on the day of the Kikuka-sho, talk of 
Biwa Hayahide's hospitalization swirled 
around. But Narita Brian paid it no mind 
and scored a crushing victory, only 
fueling the fans' burning excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Captivated by that brilliance, Sakura 
Laurel's desire to win grew stronger. 
Around that time, she caught wind of a 
rumor about Narita Brian's next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the Arima Kinen, on to the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Yet Sakura Laurel says she will 
prepare without rushing, believing that 
her idol will keep running ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, breaking news spread 
that Biwa Hayahide had suffered an injury 
during the Tenno Sho (Autumn). It was also 
reported that all her future plans were 
wiped clean.
